brand_identity.name: PreMeet
brand_identity.positioning: Crisp, confident, high-speed B2B AI Executive Assistant & Meeting Intelligence Studio
brand_identity.theme_mode: Crisp High-Contrast (Light baseline with dark focal surfaces & rich warm off-white canvas)
brand_identity.aesthetic_archetype: Swiss High-Contrast / Kinetic Precision - Crisp editorial typography, sharp borders (1px solid with 8% opacity or dark ink), vibrant electric indigo/cobalt primary trigger, high-density structured bento grids, tactile physical micro-interactions

typography.heading_font: Space Grotesk / Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.08]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-600 font-normal leading-relaxed

grid_modes.marketing_landing: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (Asymmetrical 12-col grid, gap-6 lg:gap-8, generous py-20 lg:py-28)
grid_modes.app_dashboard: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY GRID (3-col or 4-col responsive grid, gap-5, strict alignment with direct flex/grid children)
grid_modes.video_and_notes: SPLIT WORKSPACE GRID (Left 65% Daily.co video room + transcript / Right 35% live AI notes, decisions, action items & manual notes editor)

visual_enhancers.dark_glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 shadow-xl text-white
visual_enhancers.card_elevated: bg-white border border-slate-200/90 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)] hover:shadow-[0_12px_32px_-6px_rgba(15,23,42,0.12)] hover:border-slate-300 transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.badge_pill: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide border

motion_and_interaction.rules: Snappy micro-interactions, responsive click feedback, staggered card entrance, hover scale (1.02), hover lift (-translate-y-0.5), active scale-95
motion_and_interaction.framer_motion_defaults: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}

landing_page.header: Sticky navbar with glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md), logo badge, menu links, Sign In & Start Free Trial CTAs.
landing_page.hero: Bold H1 display headline, high-contrast badge 'AI Meeting Brief Studio 2.0', interactive live preview toggle (Before vs After Brief), 2 CTAs + trusted by logo strip.
landing_page.how_it_works: 3-step visual cards with step numbers, micro-illustrations, calendar sync -> auto-enrichment -> 1-page executive brief.
landing_page.example_brief_interactive: Full interactive brief card with tabs (Overview, Key Contacts, CRM History, Open Deals, Strategic Prep, Risk Signals) & source attribution chips.
landing_page.video_room_feature_highlight: Showcase built-in Daily.co call room with real-time audio transcription and automated note extraction.
landing_page.pricing: 3-tier Razorpay pricing cards (Starter Trial $0, Entry $19/mo, Professional $29/mo) with feature checklist, popular tag, and crisp CTA buttons.
landing_page.faq: Accordion-style structured FAQ with concise answers.

app_shell_and_navigation.sidebar: Clean left vertical navigation bar with brand logo, quick 'Join Next Meeting' button, NavLinks (Dashboard, Meetings, Video Room, Integrations, Client Memory, Settings, Admin), user profile drawer.
app_shell_and_navigation.top_bar: Search bar, quick notification center, current time/time-zone display, calendar sync status pill.

video_call_room_and_notes.call_layout: Responsive split screen. Left side: Daily.co embed container with full call controls (Mic, Camera, Screen Share, Live Record Indicator 'REC', Transcript Feed). Right side: AI Notes Panel with tabs (Executive Brief, Auto-Extracted Notes [Decisions, Action Items, Key Highlights], Manual Notes Editor with Markdown formatting, Export PDF button).
video_call_room_and_notes.export_pdf_button: Crisp icon button with PDF download trigger and feedback toast.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements, CTAs, navigation links, inputs, tabs, export buttons, and key data panels using kebab-case role naming (e.g. data-testid='landing-get-started-btn', data-testid='video-room-mic-toggle', data-testid='notes-export-pdf-btn', data-testid='brief-tab-action-items')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: All text elements must maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their immediate background color. Never use pure transparent backgrounds under text overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Javascript React (.js) component compatibility across all views.
Inject Google Fonts (Space Grotesk & Plus Jakarta Sans) into public/index.html or src/index.css.
Update src/index.css with the high-contrast CSS variable color palette provided.
Use Lucide React icons with explicit sizing (w-4 h-4, w-5 h-5) and strong color contrast.
Ensure all interactive components and buttons include data-testid attributes.
Utilize Sonner toasts for copy-to-clipboard, notes saving, PDF export, and setting toggles.
In the Video Call Room view, ensure seamless integration between the Daily.co video frame and the right-hand post-meeting AI notes/manual notes editor.
